name: DeepSeek Harness
postCreateCommand: npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest && npm install -g pnpm && echo '✅ dsh 已安装'
postAttachCommand: bash -lc 'export DSH_HOME="$HOME/.dsh"; if ! curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8080/; then cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web 2>/dev/null && pnpm install --silent >/dev/null 2>&1; cd /workspaces/dsh-deploy && nohup env DSH_HOME="$HOME/.dsh" PORT=8080 bash entrypoint.sh > /tmp/run.log 2>&1 & sleep 12; fi; tail -6 /tmp/run.log 2>/dev/null'
